descriptor.label: SQL DDL
descriptor.description: Export the types as SQL CREATE TABLE statements for PostgreSQL, MySQL or standard SQL: typed columns, NOT NULL and CHECK constraints, enums, and nested objects as JSON columns or tables. The same tables can be written as DBML or as a Prisma schema.
descriptor.unavailable_reason: SQL DDL export needs at least one record type (an object, struct or message); this source has none.

nested.description: `json` (default) writes a nested object, union or map as one JSON column; `tables` writes a nested object as a foreign key to its table (with synthesized keys) and a list of records or values as a junction or child table.
nested.title: Nested

schema_name.description: Qualify every table with this schema and create it first (`CREATE SCHEMA`).
schema_name.title: Schema Name

output.description: `ddl` (default) writes a SQL script; `dbml` writes the same tables as DBML; `prisma` writes them as a Prisma schema (`schema.prisma`, PostgreSQL or MySQL only); `liquibase` writes a Liquibase formatted-SQL changelog and `flyway` a Flyway migration — after the first export of an item, only the changes since the last one.
output.title: Output

from_scratch.description: `liquibase` / `flyway` only: write every table again instead of the changes since the last export (and start a new baseline).
from_scratch.title: From Scratch

changeset_author.description: `liquibase` only: the author of every changeset (`--changeset <author>:<id>`).
changeset_author.title: Changeset Author
